# Third-party components

Unichat's own code is [0BSD](LICENSE). Unichat's packages also carry the components below, each under its own license; 0BSD doesn't cover them. Generated by `native/third-party.py`.

## Included in the app

| Component | Version | License | What for |
|---|---|---|---|
| whisper.cpp (whisper-cli) | 1.9.5 | MIT | transcribing voice notes |
| libwebp (gif2webp, anim_dump) | 1.6.0 | BSD-3-Clause + patent grant | animated stickers |
| GIFLib (inside gif2webp) | 5.2.2 | MIT | reading GIFs |
| libolm | 3.2.16 | Apache-2.0 | needed by the bridges on macOS |
| tuwunel | v1.9.4 | Apache-2.0 | local Matrix server |
| JavaFX / OpenJFX | 23.0.1 | GPL-2.0 with classpath exception; WebKit, GStreamer and GLib with LGPL parts | user interface |
| Jackson (core, databind, annotations, YAML) | 2.17.2 | Apache-2.0 | JSON and YAML |
| SnakeYAML | 2.2 | Apache-2.0 | YAML |
| SQLite JDBC (includes SQLite) | 3.46.1.3 | Apache-2.0; SQLite is public domain | reading the bridges' databases |
| JNA | 5.14.0 | Apache-2.0 (chosen from Apache-2.0 and LGPL-2.1) | native calls |
| ZXing core | 3.5.3 | Apache-2.0 | QR codes |
| TwelveMonkeys ImageIO | 3.12.0 | BSD-3-Clause | reading WebP |
| JCodec (includes a decoder derived from JAAD) | 0.2.5 | BSD-2-Clause | videos from GIFs |
| jsoup | 1.18.3 | MIT | reading messages' HTML |
| Concentus | 1.0.2 | BSD-3-Clause | decoding Opus voice notes |
| Rust crates inside tuwunel | see list | several, see below | local Matrix server |
| OpenJDK (Java runtime) | that of the packaging JDK | GPL-2.0 with classpath exception | running the app |

The Java runtime's notices are in the runtime's own `legal` folder. A package built without `TUWUNEL_BIN` carries neither tuwunel nor libolm.

## Not included: downloaded when used

| Component | License |
|---|---|
| mautrix bridges (WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Meta, Discord, Slack, Google Messages, X, LinkedIn) | AGPL-3.0 |
| Whisper speech models (ggml) | MIT |
| FFmpeg, when needed and you don't have it (builds from martin-riedl.de and gyan.dev) | GPL-3.0 |
| RNNoise noise model `sh.rnnn` (GregorR/rnnoise-models), when improving voice notes | no copyright, per its author |
| For photos protected from AI: uv (astral-sh), Python, PyTorch, NumPy, Pillow, safetensors and their dependencies | MIT or Apache-2.0 (uv), PSF-2.0 (Python), BSD-3-Clause (PyTorch, NumPy), MIT-CMU (Pillow), Apache-2.0 (safetensors) |
| Stable Diffusion 1.4's image encoder weights (CompVis), for the same | CreativeML OpenRAIL-M |
| Mist's target pattern `MIST.png` (psyker-team/mist), for the same; the attack itself is Unichat's own code | GPL-3.0 |

## Notes

- **Emoji list**: `emoji/emoji.txt` is made from Unicode's `emoji-test.txt` (Emoji 15.0), under the Unicode License v3 (<https://www.unicode.org/license.txt>).
- **LGPL in JavaFX**: WebKit and GStreamer/GLib ship as separate native libraries inside JavaFX. Their source is at <https://github.com/openjdk/jfx>.
- **MPL-2.0**: tuwunel's `as_variant` crate. Its source is at <https://github.com/matrix-construct/tuwunel> and its dependencies.
- **JAAD**: JCodec carries an AAC decoder in package `net.sourceforge.jaad`, with no notice of its own in JCodec's source; it's listed under JCodec's license.

   - On Windows systems: delete $(JAVA_HOME)\bin\jfxwebkit.dll

A copy of the Oracle modified WebKit library source code is located
in the following OpenJDK git repository:

   https://github.com/openjdk/jfx

You can use git to clone the repository or you can browse the
source using a web browser. The root directory of the WebKit source
code is here:

   rt/modules/javafx.web/src/main/native/
'''
